headline: Nischay Dhankhar climbs from 503rd to 48th on ARC-2

sections.text: Nischay Dhankhar gained 18.33 points to reach 49.72, moving from 503rd to 48th in the past day.
The gain moves the entry into the top 100 on the public board. Standings remain provisional.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
